summary: C/o ED (TBCB), Power Grid Corporation of India Limited, Saudamini, Plot No.2, Sector-29, Gurgaon-122001. ** Petitioner** _(c) Pass such other order / orders, as may be deemed fit and proper in the facts & circumstances of the case.”_ 3. Notice was issued to the parties to file the reply and rejoinder. During the course of the hearing, the Petitioner’s representative submitted that the Petitioner has complied with the requirements, including publication of notice(s) under the provisions of the Transmission Licence Regulations. He further submitted that there has been a delay in filing the instant Petition on account of non-reflection of the filing fee on the e- filing portal, and accordingly prayed for condonation of the said delay. 6. During the course of the hearing on 30.4.2025, the representative of the Petitioner submitted that the name of the Petitioner company has been changed from ‘Kudankulam ISTS Transmission Limited’ to ‘POWERGRID Kudankulam Transmission Limited’ and an affidavit to this effect has been placed on record. Further, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the Respondent, Nuclear Power Corporation of India Limited (hereinafter referred to as “NPCIL”), requested a copy of the Petition and sought time to file a reply in the matter, which was allowed vide RoP for the hearing dated 30.4.2025. (b) The Petition is inconsistent with Regulations 10.7 and 10.8 of the CERC Connectivity and GNA Regulations, 2022, as no Connectivity Agreement has been executed with NPCIL, and the Petition ought to be kept in abeyance till such agreement is in place. 8. The Petitioner, vide affidavit dated 19.5.2025, has filed its rejoinder and submitted that it had no role in project planning and is functioning solely as the Transmission Service Provider. Hence, issues raised by NPCIL may be addressed by CTUIL and the BPC (PFCCL), who were involved in the planning and bidding process under the approval of MoP, GoI. The Petitioner has further submitted that implementation activities of the project have commenced, and capex is being undertaken by the Petitioner and in case NPCIL’s concerns impact the timeline or cost, the Petitioner shall be entitled to claim cost and/or time overrun, such matters being beyond its control. 9. During the course of the hearing on 17.7.2025, the representative of the Petitioner prayed for the grant of a transmission licence and submitted that the delay in the grant of the transmission licence is affecting the implementation of the Project. In addition, the representative of CTUIL submitted that NPCIL, in its reply, has raised two objections, namely: (i) absence of a connectivity agreement, and (ii) tentative nature of the commissioning dates of its units. He clarified that the Connectivity Agreement has since been executed, and with regard to the commissioning dates, NPCIL may provide the necessary clarification. The proxy counsel appearing on behalf of the Respondent, NPCIL, sought an adjournment on the ground of non-availability of the arguing counsel. 17. As per Clause 3.5.1 of the RfP document, initial offers shall be ranked on the basis of ascending order for the determination of the qualified bidders. The bidders holding the first fifty per cent of the ranks (with any fraction rounded off to a higher integer) or four Bidders, whichever is higher, shall be considered to be qualified for participating in the electronic reverse auction stage and submitting their final offer. _(10) The applicant may file its comments, duly supported by an affidavit, on the recommendations made by CTUIL and the suggestions and objections, if any, received in response to the public notice within 7 working days of receipt of such suggestions and objections, with an advance copy to the CTUIL and the person, if any, who has filed the suggestions and objections on the proposal made in the application._ _(13) The Commission may, after consideration of the further suggestions and objections, if any, received in response to the public notice in terms of Clause (12) of this Regulation, grant licence to the applicant in Form-III appended to these regulations or for reasons to be recorded in writing, reject the application._ 27. The Petitioner has published the notices on its website in Form-II in English and in the Vernacular language. The Petitioner has published the notices in the Business Line (English) and Dinamani (Tamil) on 29.1.2025. No objection has been received from the general public to the notices. 29. We have considered the submissions of the Petitioner, BPC, and CTUIL. The proviso to Clause 2.15.2 of the RfP provides that "if for any reason attributable to the BPC, the said activities are not completed by the Selected Bidder within the above period of ten (10) days as mentioned in this clause, such period of 10 days shall be extended, on a day to day basis till the end of the Bid validity period". As per the above provision, the selected bidder was required to complete all the activities, including the acquisition of SPVs, by 22.12.2024. Though the LoI was issued on 12.12.2024, BPC, vide its letter dated 10.1.2025, in terms of Clause 2.15.2 of the RfP, extended the date up to 10.1.2025 for the successful bidder to complete all activities. The selected bidder furnished the Contract Performance Guarantee in favour of the Nodal Agency (CTUIL) for an amount of Rs. 12 crores on 10.1.2025 and acquired a hundred per cent equity Order in Petition No. 245/TL/2025 39. The Petitioner has undertaken that it shall implement the Project as per the provisions of the TSA. The Petitioner has also undertaken that the time overrun and cost overrun, if applicable, shall be claimed by the Petitioner in accordance with the applicable provisions of the TSA, read with the provisions of the Act, the bidding documents, and the regulations of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission.
title: Application under Sections 14 & 15 of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Procedure, Terms and Conditions for Grant of Transmission License and other related matters) Regulations, 2024 with respect to Transmission License to POWERGRID Kudankulam Transmission Limited. POWERGRID Kudankulam Transmission Limited
